analysis:
The two units are base-side excerpts of historical CHANGELOG.md release notes (base lines 800-1253, v0.9.x and earlier). The only changed hunk in the patch excerpt is at base lines 11-13, which replaces the v0.10.0 candidate heading with a v0.10.1 candidate heading and adds rollout notes at head lines 11-138. The supplied units do not show that hunk, and the patch excerpt is truncated, so the new head text is only partly visible. I examined the visible base text, and the patch excerpt is orientation context only.

The changelog text is documentation and changes no executable behavior. The visible patch lines say the release depends on darkbloom-platform#411 coordinator logprobs gating. They also say GLM-5.3-Flash groundwork stays disabled and that page-cache accounting changes load admission and KV budgets. These are claims about external or unseen contracts. I cannot verify them from the supplied evidence, so I record them as unverified and raise no finding.

For threat T-041, the visible base entries mention the SSD prefix-cache write endurance ledger, cache-routing stale-allowlist reporting, and caller-field stripping from provider-bound bodies. They describe existing behavior and do not weaken the 30-minute TTL, the HMAC lookup names, or account-scoped salts. Nothing here invalidates the cache, attestation, App Attest or fan-helper threat assumptions.

Remaining questions for integration: whether the 0.10.1 code changes in other files match the documented claims. These are page-cache accounting changes affecting memory admission, the GLM logprob refusal dependency on a coordinator that includes platform#411, and the pinned mlx-swift-lm bump. This unit set cannot answer those questions.
